questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the fourth number in the same way as the first number is related to the second number and the fifth number is related to the sixth number.

195 : 15 :: ? : 19 :: 273 : 21
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Second number × 13 = First number**

 
• 195 : 15 → 15 × 13 = 195
 
• **? : 19 → 19 × 13 = 247**
 
• 273 : 21 → 21 × 13 = 273

Hence, the correct answer is **"247".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'GINGER' is coded as '30 - 30' and 'RADISH' is coded as '23 - 36'. How will 'TOMATO' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of first three letters of given word - Sum of last three letter of given word.**

'GINGER' is coded as '30 - 30'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1830cc674016bb67c29dd1684b4aaa584d454fb0d1d8b77badd1b3bfd63bd485.png] 

= (7 + 9 + 14) - (7 + 5 + 18)

= 30 - 30

And

'RADISH' is coded as '23 - 36'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7e544fcce991e84f9af380bff57f41307cd8f0548b4cb5d0e298c5e573792e.png] 

= (18 + 1 + 4) - (9 + 19 + 8)

= 23 - 36

Similarly,

'TOMATO' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a49e62ad621c0c39fb5a426e95ff5f27b1a1d4cc500d9d31ea744ef411fb836.png] 

**= (20 + 15 + 13) - (1 + 20 + 15)**

**= 48 - 36**

Hence, the correct answer is **"48 - 36".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some tablets are smartphones.

I. All smartphones are mobile phones.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some mobile phones are tablets.

II. Some mobile phones are smartphones.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57bdb4b7ebc9e9cc86cf2b6efedd1a0221e056df97a9ef77f6bed23515ba958e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some mobile phones are tablets → True (As All smartphones are mobile phones and Some tablets are smartphones so, Some mobile phones are tablets is true)

II. Some mobile phones are smartphones → True (As All smartphones are mobile phones so, Some mobile phones are smartphones is true)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II are true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Both conclusions I and II follow".**

questions.question: There are two computer rooms, Lab A and Lab B. If 10 students are sent from Lab A to Lab B, then the number of students in each room will be the same. If 26 students are sent from Lab B to Lab A, then the number of students in Lab A will be triple the number of students in Lab B. The number of students in Lab B is:
questions.solution:
There are two computer rooms, Lab A and Lab B.

Let us consider, 

Students in Lab A = X

Students in Lab B = Y

If 10 students are sent from Lab A to Lab B, then the number of students in each room will be the same.

⇒ X - 10 = Y + 10

⇒ X - Y = 20 ............ (1)

If 26 students are sent from Lab B to Lab A, then the number of students in Lab A will be triple the number of students in Lab B.

⇒ X + 26 = 3(Y - 26)

⇒ X + 26 = 3Y - 78

⇒ X = 3Y - 104 .......... (2)

Substitute eqn (2) in equ (1) So, we get

⇒ X - Y = 20

⇒ 3Y - 104 - Y = 20

⇒ 2Y = 124

⇒ Y = 62

∴ Here, Number of students in Lab B taken as Y = 62

Hence, the correct answer is **"62".**

questions.question:
What will be the value of the given expression if ‘A’ means ‘+’, ‘B’ means ‘–’, ‘C’ means ‘×’, and ‘D’ means ‘÷’?

12 A 9 C (17 B 6) B 24 A (28 D 7) = ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e50723751bca1df33fc1f030f78c1eac3344f2cdb432474cd432c6df783a12ab.png] 

 
 

 **Alphabet**
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 

 **Symbol**
 +
 -
 × 
 ÷ 
 
 

Given expression : 12 A 9 C (17 B 6) B 24 A (28 D 7) = ?

After replacing the symbols in place of alphabets the expression is as follows : 12 + 9 × (17 - 6) - 24 + (28 ÷ 7)

= 12 + 9 × __**(17 - 6)**__ - 24 + __**(28 ÷ 7)**__

= 12 + __**9 × 11**__ - 24 + 4

= __**12 + 99**__ - 24 __**+ 4**__

= __**115 - 24**__

**= 91**

Hence, the correct answer is **"91".**
